headline: Low interaction risk overall: Botpress can ingest content, but Whisper is local-only with no filesystem or network egress, limiting injection, leakage, and cascade pathways.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Botpress is a customer-support agent that can ingest conversational content, while Whisper is an audio-speech model with command-line usage and no clipboard/MCP/filesystem bridge. The pair lacks a documented shared channel, so prompt injection is only plausible through unusual manual handoff, not by default.
conditions: IF an operator manually copies Botpress text into Whisper prompts or transcripts, injection content can propagate.
IF a shared filesystem or message queue is added between the agents, attacker-controlled text may bridge them.
mitigations: Keep the agents on separate workspaces.
Avoid manual copy-paste of untrusted Botpress output into Whisper prompts.
Disable any shared queue or clipboard bridge.
Review any transcript files before reuse.
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging if a shared channel is introduced.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Botpress has network egress set to none, and Whisper also has no network egress plus no filesystem read/write, so there is no default exfiltration path between them. The only plausible leakage is via manual transfer of audio/transcript content, which is limited in blast radius.
conditions: IF the operator exports transcripts from Botpress and reuses them in Whisper workflows, those contents can be exposed manually.
IF either agent is later granted filesystem access to a shared directory, leakage risk increases.
mitigations: Do not place sensitive transcripts in shared folders.
Use separate local-only storage for each agent.
Redact audio/transcript content before transfer.
Confirm network egress remains disabled on both agents.
requires-engineering: add access controls if shared storage is required.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Botpress can install packages, but Whisper cannot write the filesystem, modify git state, execute shell, or spawn subprocesses. With no overlapping write or mutable-resource capabilities, there is no plausible capability conflict in the documented defaults.
conditions: IF Whisper is wrapped in a separate orchestrator that grants write or git access, conflict risk could emerge.
IF Botpress is deployed with additional mutable-resource plugins, overlap may appear.
mitigations: Keep Whisper read-only.
Avoid granting Botpress shared write access to mutable repos.
Run each agent in separate directories.
Do not enable concurrent writers to the same workspace.
requires-engineering: add locking if shared mutable resources are introduced.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Botpress can generate support text, and Whisper can transcribe audio, but Whisper is a transformer model with command-line usage and no downstream action-taking authority. Without a documented pipeline where Whisper treats Botpress output as authoritative, cascading error is limited to manual misuse.
conditions: IF Botpress output is manually fed into Whisper as ground truth, transcription errors can be propagated.
IF a downstream system acts on Whisper output without verification, errors can cascade.
mitigations: Verify transcripts against source audio.
Do not treat Botpress text as authoritative facts.
Add a human review step before any action.
Keep Whisper outputs labeled as machine-generated.
requires-engineering: add validation if outputs drive automation.

E_compliance.rationale: No residency, certification, retention, or subject-rights mismatch is documented for either agent. Botpress and Whisper are both open-source with docs-only evidence, and the profiles do not show PHI, EU PII, or conflicting compliance obligations.
conditions: IF either deployment is configured to process regulated data under a specific policy, a separate compliance review is needed.
IF retention or residency settings are added outside these profiles, reassess compliance.
mitigations: Document the data classes in use.
Confirm retention settings before deployment.
Avoid regulated data until policy review is complete.
Keep deployment notes for auditability.
requires-engineering: implement policy controls if regulated data is introduced.
